description: Use this to read what an artifact contains before revising it, answering it, or summarising it: the pushed source of the latest version or a pinned one. HTML and Markdown come back inline as `content`; PDFs and images are saved to `save_to` and the path is returned. Works with a link the user pastes, including artifacts shared with them or public ones.

artifact.description: Artifact name, team/slug, or its link (a /v/N link pins that version)

save_to.description: File path to save the content to (required for PDFs and images)

team.description: Team slug when the artifact name is ambiguous

version.description: Version number; defaults to the latest

name: get_artifact
